Reward Increased for Shooters in Ankit Baliyan Murder Case

Police have increased the reward for information leading to the arrest of the two shooters, Satyam Kadayan and Aryan, involved in the murder of Ankit Baliyan in Shamli. The reward for each has been raised to ₹1 lakh. Investigations, including GPS tracking and CCTV footage analysis, have provided significant leads. Police are conducting raids in Delhi and four other states to apprehend the fugitives.
